TABLE.NAME: block_coursesync_synclog
TABLE.COMMENT: One row per 'Sync now' run: who triggered it, when, and what happened - what was pulled, what was flagged as a conflict, what failed, and what was left for a later phase to support.

FIELD.NAME: blockinstanceid
FIELD.COMMENT: block_instances.id this run was triggered from.

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: Destination course id, denormalised here so history can be queried without joining through block_instances/context.

FIELD.NAME: success
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 if the run completed (even with individual conflicts/failures inside it), 0 if a precondition or the remote listing call itself failed.

FIELD.NAME: errorcode
FIELD.COMMENT: Set only when success=0 - see content_renderer's error-message mapping for what these mean.

FIELD.NAME: createdjson
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON list of activities created this run (remote cmid, modname, name, new local cmid).

FIELD.NAME: conflictsjson
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON list of activities flagged as conflicts (remote cmid, modname, name, and the existing local cmid/name they matched).

FIELD.NAME: failedjson
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON list of activities whose pull/create failed this run, with an error message each.

FIELD.NAME: unsupportedjson
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON list of activities detected but of a type with no activity_handler yet.

INDEX.NAME: blockinstanceid-timecreated
INDEX.COMMENT: History is always listed per block instance, most recent first.
